svg.title: The same war as four ranks see it

g.text: “They say the bridge is held against us.”
“A carter saw a wagon train burning behind us.”
Bread for four days · day 33 of your forty
the rest you know only by hearsay
the road, the camp, and what the men say
Orders, by courier at noon: “Hold the bridge end until the horns.”
a ride round his company; his wing; his orders
the theatre, as far as his riders see; the rest is a guess
Called at Michaelmas: three more banners, on the road
The Duke’s forty days end at Martinmas · the chest holds pay for two months
every army, by courier and days late; who is called, who is paid
